conversion.method: original world STL + product joint ownership; no CAD execution

moving_coverage.basis: Source envelopes combine rotating and fixed subcomponents. Whole-envelope support ownership is presentation only; rotating internal components are not independently resolved. Tyres and separate turret flywheels still require motion traces.

frame_contract: Original world CAD-mm/Z-up vertices; each display mesh is localized by the inverse owner home world matrix. Right module is a proper RZ180 rotation. All child origins/axes are in parent-local CAD coordinates.

fivebar.wheel_hub_basis: Unsplit drum+axle source envelope translates at apex; only tyre spins.

limits: Presentation of accepted tessellated envelopes only. No new physics, mass/COM, continuous clearance, bought-interface, load, support, drop, physical fit or manufacturing qualification. Historical studies keep their original geometry, frames and failures.
